shard_note: Articles are spread over the shards by hash, so a missing shard removes a random slice of about 1/14 of articles. Counts are lower by that slice; shares and sentiment are unaffected.
definition: Business & financial news = articles whose top-scoring topic label sits under Business & Industrial, Finance or Real Estate.
sentiment_method: Each article carries model sentiment labels (extreme/very/fair/slight x positive/negative, or none). The top-scoring label decides the article's polarity. Net sentiment = (positive - negative) / all articles x 100. Tone = mean of the label weight (extreme 1, very 0.75, fair 0.5, slight 0.25, negative sign for negative, 0 for none) x 100.
